clues: This city is the capital of its prefecture in Japan. It sits on Kyushu, a big island in the south of the land.
Bar two, this is the wettest big city in all of Japan. Its summers are long, hot, and so wet that the air feels thick.
This port was founded by men from Portugal long ago. For years, it was the one port where Dutch and Portuguese ships could trade.
Near the end of World War Two, an atomic bomb struck this city. It was just the second city on Earth to face such a blast.
The hidden Christian sites near this city hold a place on the UNESCO World Heritage list. That list marks the most prized sites on Earth.
